title: The watch screen log says it holds only screen times and settings, but it also sends when a workout was open and the watch app version
what: The caption under 'Add my watch's screen log' says it holds only the times the watch screen turned on, off or dim and the Battery Saver and screen settings. The log that is sent also marks, line by line with times, whether a workout was open, and names the watch app version and the last update pop-up decision.
expected: The caption names everything the log carries, or the log leaves out what the caption does not name.
who: members with the watch app who send feedback
how_often: every time the log is sent
fix_line: Add 'when a workout was open and the watch app version' to the caption
